report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. The only deployment record is baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. Order metrics show 200s on v1.0.0 with zero 502s; payment shows 200s and zero 503s. No evidence of checkout errors exists, so no bounded cause can be substantiated.
missing_evidence: Logs for order, payment and gateway (excluded from context) to confirm or refute checkout errors
Error-rate or 5xx metrics for the checkout/gateway route showing actual checkout failures
Deployment records for order/payment versions beyond baseline v1.0.0 to test the deployment hypothesis
Trace or metric evidence of latency/error spikes correlated with any deployment timestamp
